question: Will Netanyahu's bloc win more Knesset seats than the opposition bloc in the October 27, 2026 election?
resolution_criteria: Yes if Likud, Otzma Yehudit, Religious Zionism-Zehut, Amcha Yisrael, United Torah Judaism and Shas together win more seats than The Democrats, Yashar, Together and Yisrael Beiteinu together, in the official results of the Central Elections Committee. Seats of other parties are not counted.

history.rationale: 10/27/2026 update to the market price 31.5%. No independent news view.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved yes. Our last number was 31.5%; the market's last saved price before archival was 98.65%. Brier 0.469. Official CEC results certified 2026-11-04 (israelvote.meforum.org, israelnationalnews.com/news/435272): Likud 27, Yashar 21, Together 12, Joint List 11, Democrats 8, Raam 8, Yisrael Beytenu 7 (5.93%), Otzma 7, UTJ 7, Shas 6, RZ-Zehut 6; Netanyahu bloc 53, opposition 48, Arab parties 19; Amcha Yisrael 1.68%, below the threshold.
